newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woolworths sees wholesale profit soon.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woolworths sees wholesale profit soon.

text.p: Woolworths Ltd expected to make a small profit from the expansion of its wholesaling operations within the first year, managing director Reg Clairs said in a television interview broadcast on Sunday.

"We will be able to make a profit out of it ... within the first 12 months," Clairs told the Nine Network's Business Sunday programme. "We're not going into it unless there is a return on an investment of our shareholders."
Research had showed Woolworths would do little better than break-even from the expansion.

Earlier this month Woolworths announced it would expand its wholesaling operations through its Australian Independent Wholesalers Pty Ltd (AIW) unit, but did not give any financial details of the move.
Woolworths acquired AIW in July last year as part of its purchase of the Cannons group of stores.
